target: The precise ratio-free positive-fraction large-rectangle conclusion for restricted sumsets of finite integer sets.
accepted_conclusion: At fixed delta=1/2 and C=1, no positive retained fraction c and finite bound K uniformly yield |A_prime+B_prime|<=K|A| under the stated graph-density and restricted-sum hypotheses.
quantifier_negation: For every c,K>0 there exist finite A,B in Z with |A|=m>|B|=n and G subset A x B, |G|>=mn/2 and |A+_G B|<m, such that every A_prime,B_prime with |A_prime|>=cm and |B_prime|>=cn has |A_prime+B_prime|>Km.
prior_attribution: Green–Kane, arXiv:1703.01036v2, section 4, page 5; observation credited there to Hosseini, Impagliazzo and Lovett.
